text:
maria (PM): Draft PRD uploaded -> https://redwood.app/s/PRD-cross-endpoint. Need quick sweep: acceptance criteria, edge cases, launch gates for chat/completions + embeddings + rerank. Planning 2-week beta for Dedicated customers.

sam (eng): skimmed the doc. major ask: clarify per-route rate limits and default fallback model when capacity is low. we should define a transparent policy for routing to cheaper quantized variants.

toni (eng-ml): +1. For rerank, we need a clear max latency target at p95/p99. Rerank does synchronous scoring so p99 under 250ms seems reasonable for 8-doc reranks; otherwise provide async job mode. Also: embeddings vector dim mismatch handling (reject vs auto-proj) needs callout.

alex (devex): SDK impact: version bump and new endpoints for streaming + rerank batch. We should include example snippets for Node/Python and an automated migration guide. Deprecation window: 60 days after GA for old param names.

chris (security): For Private & Dedicated launches: confirm KMS flow for per-tenant model keys + audit logs. PRD currently says KMS optional; make it required for customers with compliance flag. Also add threat model for model fallback (data leakage across variants).

amanda (cs): Customer ask: large marketplace customer needs embeddings similarity search SLO <= 100ms median for 1k-QPS. We probably need a tiered promise (Dedicated vs Hosted). Bringing them into beta only if Dedicated capacity can be reserved.

ira (design): Console UX: add rollout toggle per-model and per-route with canary percent + automatic fallback control. Mockups in drive: /design/rollout-toggle-v2.png. Need acceptance criteria that UX surfaces when a request is routed to fallback.

maria (PM): Proposed launch gates (short):
- Acceptance: chat/completions stream + non-streaming complete correctness tests, embeddings recall/regression <= 2% vs baseline, rerank NDCG delta <= 1.5% on prod-like benchmarks.
- Reliability: p95 latency targets for each route, p99 tail SLAs per doc.
- Security/compliance: KMS + audit logging for Private customers on beta.
- Ops: deployable canary, automated rollback, alerting for model QA regressions.

sam (eng): add automated smoke that exercises fallback path under controlled capacity pressure. CI should simulate quantized-variant output parity checks.

toni (eng-ml): add eval-suite: prompt set of 200 edge prompts covering long context, truncated tokens, rare tokens, multi-turn preserves KV cache. tie regressions to blocking CI.

alex (devex): suggest adding sample code for delta upgrade path:```
# python
client.upgrade(model='redwood-chat-v2', fallback='redwood-chat-lite', allow_mismatch=False)
```
Include example error states.

chris (security): Also require a review checklist for model onboarding: data provenance, license check, quantization artifacts, FIPS/KMS compatibility.

amanda (cs): I'll collect the customer acceptance tests and coordinate two beta seats (marketplace + fintech). Need feature flag by next Wed.

deploy-bot: Canary plan scheduled: canary window 2025-06-12T08:00Z -> 2025-06-14T20:00Z. Auto-rollback on error rate > 0.5% or latency spike > 2x baseline.

ira (design): tiny UX edge: when embeddings are auto-projected we should show a warning and allow opt-out.

maria (PM): Action items/owners: sam -> rate limit & fallback policy doc (due 3 days). toni -> evaluation harness + 200 prompt set (due 5 days). alex -> SDK snippets + migration guide (due 4 days). chris -> security onboarding checklist (due 6 days). amanda -> beta customer coordination + feature flags (due 7 days). ira -> console mocks + tooltip copy (due 4 days). I'll update PRD with gates and acceptance matrix tonight.

sam (eng): quick Q: do we require cross-route batching for embeddings+rerrank co-requests? could be large ops. recommend optional batching with opt-in.

toni (eng-ml): optional is fine, but add explicit quota & max-batch-size limits. otherwise tail latency explodes.

maria (PM): noted. I'll add an opt-in batching section and default conservative batch sizes.

alex (devex): final: can we get a light regression harness run on staging by EOD Friday? I can kick off once toni drops prompt set.

maria (PM): thanks everyone. tagging @sam @toni @alex for followups. please add short comments inline on the PRD doc instead of long threads.

maria (PM): bump for visibility — updated the PRD with the acceptance matrix: https://redwood.app/s/PRD-cross-endpoint#acceptance-matrix

sam (eng): saw it. leaving inline comment about fallback telemetry metrics.

toni (eng-ml): leaving eval artifacts in /ml/evals/cross-endpoint-beta.

amanda (cs): will schedule kickoff with beta customers for next Tue.

chris (security): scheduling security review next Mon.

ira (design): uploaded final tooltip copy.

maria (PM): closing thread — will post final signoff checklist when all owners mark done. :thumbsup:
